main_text.l: Niphal נִשְׂכַּר Conduci. Hithp. הִשְׂתַּכֵּר Idem, vel Mercedem accipere, Persolvi.
שָׂכִיר m. Mercenarius, Mercede conducus plur. שְׂכִירִים.
שֶׁל Vocula Hebraea usitata pro articulo genitivi casus. Hinc בְּשֶׁל Propter.
בִּשְׁלִי Propter me, בִּשְׁלְמִי Propter quē: שַׁלְמָה Propter quid, pro בִּשְׁלָמָה, & Pathach est loco Segol.
שֶׁלָב m. Scala: plur. שְׁלָבִים Gradus, Scala: metaphoricè Prominentiae gradata.
מִשְׁלָבֶת f. plur. Graduati, instar graduum dispositi.
שָׁלָה Tranquillum esse, Quiescere. Niphal נִשְׁלָה Errare. Hiphil הִשְׁלָה Errare fecit, Fefellit.
שָׁלִיו, שַׁלְיוֹ, שָׁלִיו m. Tranquillus: plur. שַׁלְיוֹם.

page.notes: Vowel points and Hebrew forms are read from a small, worn scan; the Hebrew vocalisation in several headwords (notably lines 8, 10 and 16) is uncertain. The top-left page number and running head are hard to read and may be misread.
